operation.summary: Applet-specific (A Sorta Fairytale About Me only; not a general platform service). Create a kind fairy tale or wild fictional story from 2–8 kept video frame captures, a portrait and optional context, using GLM 5.3 Flash. Images must be accessible to this caller; no new capture or location read.

body.name: context
body.description: Optional context already read through /services/context; treated as untrusted observations

operation.returns: title, narration, inventory, mode, model, cost_usd, elapsed_ms, presentation_token. The caller chooses which fields to keep in its own declared tables.

context.description: Optional context already read through /services/context; treated as untrusted observations
